lines.t: Verse 1
I was standing on the edge and slipping fast
All the heartbreak piling higher, falling back
But You reached into my trembling
Said You’d hold me through the breaking
And You lifted me before I even asked
Pre-Chorus
I was sinking, I was reaching
For a hope I couldn’t find
But You caught me when I stumbled
Pulled me back into the light
Now I’m falling into grace
Like the mercy in Your name
All the weight I carried fades
’Cause You’re holding me, You’re holding me
I was drifting far away
But You called me through the waves
Now I’m rising ’cause You stay
And You’re holding me, You’re holding me
I’m falling into grace
Verse 2
Every burden that I laid before Your feet
You turned ashes into something I can keep
Now the scars that once defined me
Are the stories You remind me
How Your love can turn the broken into peace
Pre-Chorus
I was sinking, I was reaching
For a hope I couldn’t find
But You caught me when I stumbled
Pulled me back into the light
Chorus
Now I’m falling into grace
Like the mercy in Your name
All the weight I carried fades
’Cause You’re holding me, You’re holding me
I was drifting far away
But You called me through the waves
Now I’m rising ’cause You stay

Bridge
I surrender, take it all
Every fear and every fall
You restore the broken heart
With Your love, with Your love
Now I’m falling into grace
Every chain is washed away
You revive my weary faith
’Cause You’re holding me, You’re holding me
I was drifting far away
But You called me through the waves
Now I’m rising ’cause You stay
And You’re holding me, You’re holding me
I’m falling into grace
